high_level_description: This image captures the iconic Madison Square Garden at night, illuminated by bright lights that highlight its distinctive architecture. The building's exterior is predominantly dark, with vertical light strips running along its facade, creating a striking contrast against the night sky. A large digital billboard on the side of the building displays a vivid red lipstick kiss mark on a white background, adding a pop of color to the scene. The street in front of the arena is bustling with activity. Several vehicles, including police cars and other vehicles, are parked or moving along the road.
